outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single deconvoluted mass spectrum for cadmium binding to PacL1. Neither the panel nor the caption states whether this spectrum is representative of multiple independent measurements/protein preparations, nor how many replicates were performed.

Panel B shows a single deconvoluted mass spectrum for PacL1Δ5. There is no statement of how many times the native MS measurement was repeated or what kind of replicate (biological/technical) it represents.

Panel C quantifies the proportion of PacL1, PacL1Δ5 and PacL2 bound to 0-3 cadmium atoms by native MS, but the caption gives no indication of the number of independent measurements/protein preparations underlying each bar or the replicate type.
Panel D quantifies zinc-bound species by native MS with no reported n or replicate type for the underlying measurements.
Panel E quantifies copper-bound species by native MS with no reported n or replicate type for the underlying measurements.
Panel F quantifies manganese-bound species by native MS with no reported n or replicate type for the underlying measurements.

Panel G summarizes NMR chemical shift perturbations of PacL1 upon zinc titration at three equivalents. The caption does not state whether the titration/NMR experiment was performed once or repeated, nor any replicate type.

Panel H summarizes NMR chemical shift perturbations of PacL1 upon cadmium titration at three equivalents. The caption does not state whether the titration/NMR experiment was performed once or repeated, nor any replicate type.
